quick: Hit level 12. Sign up with Arthur in Henesys Town Hall or Roxy in the Kerning City Civic Center.
Every day, open your town's Community Board and greet that day's neighbor. That's +100 points, more at higher grades.

citizenship.daily: Each day the board shows one neighbor. Your first visit is a "First Greeting" and later visits are "Asking After". Each one is worth 100 points at grade 1, plus 25 for every grade above that (325 at grade 10), with a little EXP, mesos and a fruit snack. From grade 5 (level 32) you also get VIP neighbors whose greetings pay about 5,850 EXP.

citizenship.chair: Resident's Chair: 500,000 mesos at grade 2 from Oak (Henesys) or Weston (Kerning). +20 HP and +5 MP every 10 seconds. Untradeable, one per town. It cost 10,000 in the closed test, so don't trust old guides.
faq: How do I become a citizen in MapleStory Classic?
At level 12, sign up with Arthur in Henesys Town Hall or Roxy in the Kerning City Civic Center. A quest starts on its own at level 12 to walk you there.
Should I pick Henesys or Kerning City?

Warriors and bowmen should pick Henesys for 2-meso Bronze Arrows, accuracy potions and STR/DEX scrolls. Thieves and magicians should pick Kerning for 1,000-meso Wolbi stars, avoid potions and LUK/INT scrolls. Housing, discounts and story quests are the same in both.
How do I get a house in MapleStory Classic?

Become a citizen of Henesys or Kerning City and reach citizenship grade 2: level 17 plus 1,500 points, about 8 days of daily greetings and a weekly donation. Then talk to the estate agent in your town.
How much does a house cost?
Nexon hasn't published a price. We'll add it once housing is live on Oct 21.
How much does it cost to change citizenship?
Between 50,000 and 100,000 mesos; sources disagree and it may depend on your grade. Your progress in the old town is kept if you return.
How fast can I rank up?
One daily greeting (100+ points) and one weekly donation (700+ points) gets grade 2 in about 8 days. Grade 10 takes most of a year at that pace.

mark.intro: Jay found an old adventurer's journal with the middle pages torn out. Each page is hidden somewhere on Victoria Island, and the clues are written like riddles. All 7 quests need level 25.

steps.title: The Marks We Leave Behind
steps.do: Talk to Jay in the middle of Henesys. He hands you the Adventurer's Journal. Read page 1.

steps.title: The First Mark
steps.clue: a shore guarded by little snouts
steps.do: Go to The Pig Beach near Lith Harbor and search the crack in the rocks for page 2.

steps.title: The Second Mark
steps.clue: one night beneath a stranger's roof
steps.do: Hunt the monsters inside Someone Else's House until page 3 drops.

steps.title: The Third Mark
steps.do: Climb to the old tree high up in Marr's Forest. Page 4 is there.

steps.title: The Fourth Mark
steps.do: A nameless thief in Kerning City (Mong from Kong) sells page 5 for 10 mesos. Bargain!

steps.title: The Fifth Mark
steps.do: Collect 4 scraps and put them together for page 6. The exact map isn't confirmed yet; it's somewhere off the usual paths.

steps.title: The Final Mark
steps.do: Head to the end of Ant Tunnel Park and take the hidden portal. The Mark of the Beta is yours.

mark.reward: Mark of the Beta: a hat with +1 STR, DEX, INT and LUK, 15 weapon defense and 7 upgrade slots. Untradeable. That's a great free hat to scroll.
mark.note: Steps come from the game files (via NiaMeowDB and henesys.gg). The EXP and meso rewards aren't in the files. If you finish step 6, tell us where the scraps were!
mark.rings: Played a closed test? Accounts that finished both test events (A Strange and Familiar Wood, and Beyond the Unknown) can claim the Classic Beginnings Label Ring and Chat Ring at launch. Nexon hasn't said how yet.

how: Collect 30 Maple Leaves. Any level 10+ monster can drop them, so just play.
Bring them to the Maple Administrator: far left of Henesys, or the new one in Kerning City.
Get that day's gift. Come back tomorrow for the next one.
journey.gifts: Nexon's launch slide showed a Snail pet that picks up mesos and items, potions, megaphones and other consumables, plus something to open a shop with. The day-by-day list isn't public yet.
journey.note: It counts claims, not calendar days, so a missed day just pushes your last gift back. The event pet in the files lasts until Nov 19, which is why we think the event ends around Nov 18. Megaphones from events after launch need level 15.

steps.title: Find Malady
steps.do: She's on the left side of Kerning City from Oct 28. Accept [Event] Halloween Candies.

steps.title: Collect 100 Halloween Candies
steps.do: Any level 10+ monster can drop them. The quest names Ribbon Pigs, Dark Stumps, Octopuses and Green Mushrooms. Accept the quest first; the candy may only drop while it's active.

steps.title: Trick or treat!
steps.do: Malady splits the candy into 3 pouches. Deliver one each to the child in the dark tunnel, the child on the open field and the child up on the high ground.

steps.title: Back to Malady
steps.do: Turn in [Event] Trick or Treat! for her reward. Got extra candy? Trade it in at the Maple Administrator in Henesys.

halloween.maybeNote: In the game files but not confirmed as rewards: Malady's Candy (Red heals 600 HP, Blue 450 MP, Green 300 of each), the Pumpkin Basket (a one-handed sword with 24 attack, +1 all stats and +8 speed) and a Halloween Broomstick Chair. Pumpkin and witch outfits are probably for a Halloween fashion crate in the Cash Shop.
tips: Candy stacks to 100, can't be traded and is time-limited. Don't plan to sell it.
Farm the busiest level 10+ map you can clear fast. Kill speed beats monster level here.
The "dark tunnel" child might be in the Kerning subway. That's our guess until someone confirms it.
It doesn't look repeatable, so it's probably one run per character.
halloween.note: Quest text comes from the game files. Nexon hasn't posted the rewards, the candy drop rate or the exchange list yet. We'll update this on Oct 28.

faq: How do you do Mark of the Beta in MapleStory Classic?

Talk to Jay in Henesys at level 25. Then find the journal's missing pages: Pig Beach rocks, Someone Else's House, the old tree in Marr's Forest, a thief in Kerning (10 mesos), four scraps, and the hidden portal at the end of Ant Tunnel Park.
What does Mark of the Beta give?
A hat with +1 to all stats, 15 weapon defense and 7 slots. It's untradeable.
When is the MapleStory Classic Halloween event?
From Oct 28, 2026. The game files run it to about Nov 18. Talk to Malady on the left side of Kerning City.
Where do Halloween Candies drop?
From any level 10+ monster while you have the quest. Accept it from Malady first.
What is The Journey Begins?
A daily launch gift from Oct 21. Bring 30 Maple Leaves to the Maple Administrator for one of 14 gifts.

faq: How do I open a shop in MapleStory Classic?

Buy a store permit in the Cash Shop (Regular is 1,500 NX for 90 days and 12 items), then open it in the Free Market or in a field. Stay online: Hired Merchants aren't sold yet, and a monster hit closes your shop.
Where is the Free Market?
The Free Market Entrance has portals from Perion and Henesys Market and leads to 11 rooms. Leaving takes you back to the town you came from.
How do I price items?
Use the price someone actually paid, not other listings. Listings run about 40% above sale prices, so pricing at the sold median sells fast.
Is there a trade tax?
Nobody has published one for Classic.
Can I get banned for buying mesos?
Yes. Nexon bans real-money trading, and the ban covers your main MapleStory account too.

endgame.hitNote: Uses NiaMeowDB's hit formula. Being below a monster's level makes it harder to hit; at or above its level, extra levels add damage, not accuracy. Check your ACC in the stat window.
